claims.claim: The reported final evaluation completed, was qualified, and reports correct=true; qualification is independent of a favorable scientific result.
The frozen configuration was selected without a qualifying development improvement; the development record is not final reliability evidence.
Detailed retained final diagnostics are marked unverified; arithmetic reconstruction is not an independent execution or adaptivity audit.
Supplied source and sealed evaluation carry different recorded tree identities; exact executed-source identity is not authenticated.
Aggregate top-three repeat overlap is 0.9458719135802469 and reference-fidelity quality is 0.9289530659189914, rounded in the abstract and results.
Aggregate enforced-efficiency quality is 0.9999999999999954; it is not an attribution-accuracy certificate.
Aggregate four-short-minus-one-long reference-quality difference is -0.03883354541895445, rounded in the abstract and results.
The fixed empirical game averages positive-class probability over fixed training-background rows, masking original columns before preprocessing; equations 1 and 2 define that target.

The readable supplied sampler uses randomized kernel-size stratification, complement coverage, random orientation, the stated pair cap, and efficiency-constrained equal-weight least squares with rcond=1e-10; this is a source-scoped description, not exact sealed-source authentication.
The original comparator uses independent kernel-size/subset sampling and the same solver; no paired final attribution arrays establish its numerical comparison with the frozen sampler.
The measured deployment comparator is package KernelExplainer with identity link, l1_reg=0 and requested interior sample count q-2; it is distinct from the original independent sampler.

The audit covers German Credit with 20 original players and ACSIncome with 10, three classifier families, fitted seeds 7301 and 9109, 12 explained inputs per fitted family, background sizes 8 and 32, budgets 64 and 256, and six repetitions per budget.
Training/validation/explanation-pool counts are 356/125/131 for German Credit and 10000/3000/3000 for ACSIncome.
There are 12 non-replay scientific fitted conditions and 288 input/background cells; terminal replay is excluded.
ACSIncome uses exact enumeration of 1024 coalitions; German Credit uses two independently seeded package references at total nominal budget 2048, including endpoints.

Supplied preprocessing uses training-only median imputation/scaling and unknown-tolerant dense one-hot encoding; logistic C=1/max_iter=200, forest 64 trees/depth 6/one thread, and boosting 64 estimators/depth 3.
Explained inputs alternate labels and prediction-probability positions; backgrounds are nested seeded training permutations rather than population samples.
The retained protocol reports content-hash-based development/final and train/validation/explanation separation, zero content overlap in the manifest, duplicate grouping and source-order caps.
Repeat agreement is raw top-min(3,d) absolute-feature set overlap with stable ties; it is not a reliability probability or a chance-corrected rate.
Q(a,r)=1/(1+L1(a-r)/max(1e-8,L1(r))); German ordinary fidelity averages two Q values whereas allocation uses the mean reference vector; local quality uses residual/1e-6.

Four additional independent 64-coalition calls are averaged and compared against the first 256-coalition call, not against a selected best call; coalition counts and studied masked rows match at fixed background length.

Stored descriptive 95% intervals use 200 explained-input-cluster percentile bootstrap draws within a fit; seed 812, quantiles .025 and .975; six repeats provide 15 dependent unordered repeat pairs per budget.
Figure agreement_and_reference_fidelity displays case means and stored pooled within-fit intervals; no budget-specific confidence interval is inferred.
German case fidelity means range 0.8453 to 0.9153 and ACSIncome 0.9632 to 0.9897; German forest overlaps are 0.9019/0.9241 and fidelities 0.8710/0.8685 for the two seeds.
German approximate-reference agreement case means range 0.9801 to 0.9910 and do not certify convergence.
All twelve case allocation means and stored interval upper bounds are negative; German means range -0.1067 to -0.0526 and ACSIncome means -0.0078 to -0.0018.
Figure budget_allocation_contrast shows the two fitted seeds and the stored within-fit descriptive cluster intervals, with negative direction favoring one longer call.

At budget 64 every German package mean exceeds its studied counterpart; package means span 0.8644-0.9354 and studied means 0.7470-0.8593. ACSIncome studied means span 0.9474-0.9853 and exceed corresponding package means.
At budget 256 every studied case mean exceeds its corresponding 64-budget mean; German values span 0.9436-0.9736 and ACSIncome values 0.9791-0.9942; package differences have both signs.

Figure deployment_estimator_comparison reports deterministic budget-specific fidelity reductions; six studied repetitions and one retained package call per cell/budget; no package seed variance or budget-specific test is estimated.
Table measured work lists studied prediction rows 512,2048,2048,8192 and library rows 505,2041,2017,8161 for (m,q)=(8,64),(8,256),(32,64),(32,256) on each dataset.

German mean studied wall seconds are .0173,.0563,.0242,.0808 and library CPU seconds .0198,.0290,.0265,.0573; ACSIncome studied wall seconds are .0174,.0576,.0248,.0859 and library CPU seconds .0187,.0280,.0250,.0690; the clocks differ.
Data provenance identifies California 2024 one-year ACS PUMS; source counts 1000 German and 203591 ACS; final capped pool sizes are not explained-decision counts.
ACS features, German numeric positions, relationship-code adaptation, normalization and target coding are documented as protocol configuration, not measured causal mechanisms.
Supplementary rank agreement uses normalized Spearman footrule; sign agreement uses a 1e-8 zero tolerance; supplementary table values are the retained-pair and validation-accuracy reductions.
All reconstructed cell fidelities, overlaps, and allocation differences match stored values within floating-point precision; reconstruction does not authenticate underlying execution.
The recorded environment pins Python 3.12.15, NumPy 2.2.6, SciPy 1.15.3, pandas 2.2.3, scikit-learn 1.6.1, SHAP .48.0 and folktables .0.12; evaluator computation is CPU-only with one core/thread.
Episode wall durations are 222.47809640003834 and 194.9853834430687 seconds, rounded to 222.48 and 194.99; not total campaign CPU use.
Only the first full query/regression trace per case and trace digests are retained, not a complete raw-mask archive.

Efficiency can be preserved by a zero-sum attribution perturbation and top-feature overlap can be preserved by magnitude perturbations that do not change the selected set; these are metric properties, not measured experiments.
The complement or inverse of mean bounded quality is not mean normalized attribution error; pooling backgrounds averages different empirical games rather than supplying a per-input acceptance rule.
